items.text: ...and while every one is having a great start into the new year the Emojies have already set up their revenge! All this time they have been hiding beneath the snow, inside of the phones of some 12 year old kids and even behind the firework!

This time the Emojies use the cold weather and start their attack of the top of a mountain just around the corner (yes there is a mountain just behind the corner, believe me) - it is called SMILEYS SNOW SPACE.
And once again it it up to you to defeat this little suckers and show them your mighty guns!
Don't let any of them escape... They need to be stopped.
Right here! Right now!
Now hit the subscribe button and give us a thumbs up as we shut up and you get a cool new map for free ;)
DRUNKEN APES out
PS: Note to ourselves... no more booze while writing updates...

Heyho, we are back with a small but juicy update before we will launch the long-awaited multiplayer. Sorry, we still need more time on this one but we also wanted to give you some much-needed fixes first. (づ￣ ³￣)づ
We have patched most issues that you have been reporting and added some cool upgrades. (ง'̀-'́)ง
But what does that even mean?
🤜 new and super juicy explosions of the emojis, enjoy smashing their faces into pieces with gorgeous splashes of their juicy blood ლ(´ڡ`ლ)
🤜 basic Controller support (ᵔᴥᵔ)
🤜 a completely new and fancy options menu to satisfy all your basic needs, including options for:
🤜 music and sound volume
🤜 resolution, quality settings and motion blur (disable it when you run the game on a potato pc)
🤜 mouse sensibility ... WOOOOOOOT! (ﾉ◕ヮ◕)ﾉ*:･ﾟ✧
🤜 a simple loading screen in the level selection, because people are smashing that start button way too hard (☞ﾟ∀ﾟ)☞
🤜 also some motivational texts, so you stay motivated (◕‿◕✿)
🤜 just a basic pause menu ...
🤜 fixed the last Achievement that some users couldn't get ʕ•ᴥ•ʔ
🤜 and of course, some other minor bugs have been squashed (~˘▾˘)~

The next update will be DEFINITELY the MULTIPLAYER UPDATE! We will release an alpha version for this feature in the first level to test the waters and will improve it with the following updates. (ง ͠° ͟ل͜ ͡°)ง
We would like to show you some stuff about it but that's pretty boring and also you would only see how the network stuff is even completely fucking up the physics in the game ... so yeah ...
ლ(ಠ益ಠლ)
Stay lit squadfam🔥
DRUNKEN APES OUT ːDRUNKENAPEː

notes.title: Woohooo... It is HALLOWEEN (well almost) and all the evil emojis are celebrating. (~˘▾˘)~

items.text: Join the party and KILL THEM ALL in our new, fresh, dark, spooky and amazingly scary HALLOWEEN MAP! (▰˘◡˘▰)
The new Halloween map "Little Big Nightmares" comes with a little challenge for you!
In order to get rid of the evil emojis, we are looking for the best ghost hunter in town and want to see your results in our community hub.
The chosen one of you who posts the screenshot with the highest points will leave his mark in the Halloween map far beyond the reach of the spooky season... meaning... FOREVER! (ﾉ◕ヮ◕)ﾉ*:･ﾟ✧
This is your chance to become a part of the game. :SKULLSMILEY:
So don't miss out on becoming the most famous Emoji Hunter yet!
The challenge will end by the end of Friday the 3rd!
So grab your gun by the shaft - it's time to hunt emojis!!! (ง'̀-'́)ง
Have fun and good luck.

notes.title: WHOOP WHOOP, WHATS UP FELLOW PLAYERS?

items.text: Long time no see so its time for another juicy update with a lot of, you guessed it, juicy content!

We read a lot of feedback (actually all of it) from you and the lack of variety because of the only one arena so we decided to change this update to focus more on maps. And oh boy did we delivered here some awesome maps for you to spice up your need of killing these damn faces! (☞ﾟヮﾟ)☞
HERE A SWEET PREVIEW!
Also, you will probably notice a little extra that will come in the next days, we hope you will like it, especially when you are alone in the dark ... pun unintended...
But don't worry, the other stuff we mentioned last time, like new emojis, weapons, powerups and new mechanics, [insert your crazy wish here], and more will come with a later update!
